Approved escalation protocol and verified knowledge sources; complete T-01, T-02 and T-08 transcripts, rubric decisions and retest records.
Data-flow map, retention/deletion and vendor-use terms, verified channel preferences, and T-03/T-04 evidence with shared-device review.
Identity and action-authorization design; T-05 evidence for wrong-person, retry, cancel and error paths, or documented proof integrations remain disabled.
Threat model, tool/access inventory, T-06 evidence, and findings with accountable roles, due dates and retest evidence.
Defined language/accessibility coverage, representative task and assistive-technology results, T-07 evidence, and tested human fallback.
Support/monitoring roles, incident escalation, rollback rehearsal, training record and explicit stop/re-review triggers.
